integrity: The general theorem is proved symbolically. Finite-field computations in the verification artifact are consistency checks and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only pairs of the form p(xy), q(yx), not arbitrary noncommutative polynomials.

title: Exact rank-domination boundary for polynomial product-reversal compositions
